plan.title: The Ashen Ledger
plan.grammar: A compact occult-detective RPG: two investigators follow spectral evidence through a shuttered archive and confront the witness that erased itself from every record.
plan.startup: Ordinary title -> new session -> archive map with the two detectives already in the party.
plan.playableProof: Choose Open Case, step into the archive, and use Project-owned investigative rites against the Redacted Witness.
plan.contentBudget: One archive map, two investigators, one spectral adversary, three rites, two evidence elements, and one named condition.
